t: What Personal AI Trader Fleets Is
title: What Personal AI Trader Fleets Is
definition: Personal AI Trader Fleets: personal AIs trading on your behalf.
description:
Personal AI Trader Fleets: personal AIs trading on your behalf. This is Post-Scarcity Economy at its most ambitious — trader agents research, fleet logistics engineering and risk limits operations converging on a single goal: making fleet hulls real.

Why it matters: Post-Scarcity Economy will decide audit trails outcomes this century. Personal AI Trader Fleets is one of the load-bearing ideas: without working fleet hulls, the larger trader agents vision stalls, and with it, the fleet logistics systems that depend on it.

This database documents Personal AI Trader Fleets in full: what it is, the real research behind it today, the pieces it is built from, dated forecasts, runnable demo programs, and a teaching ladder from foundations to mastery. Every record carries a working program you can run.

description:

definition: Estimates Personal AI Trader Fleets readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Personal AI Trader Fleets components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a fleet hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

t: Personal AI Trader Fleets Master Roadmap
title: Personal AI Trader Fleets Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Personal AI Trader Fleets: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Personal AI Trader Fleets — personal AIs trading on your behalf.

Phase 1 — Prove (trader agents): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (fleet logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (risk limits): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (audit trails): fleet hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and consumers-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
